parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh-CN**: Chinese.

- **en-US**: English.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the scheduling instance. Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is **100**. The default value is **20**.
